name: Motor fit coupon
identify: Short carrier section with the motor pocket; not installed on the robot.

name: Bearing fit coupon
identify: Four rings, bores 19.0 / 19.1 / 19.2 / 19.3 mm. Labels were not visible on the printed sample; alternating holes accepted the bearing. Retain the sample; no repeat print required.

name: Track carrier
identify: Long body with integral motor housing, continuous backplate and slotted idler boss.

name: Fixed bracket
identify: Bracket with two carrier holes and four chassis-foot holes.

name: Tip hub
identify: Revised hub: Ø30 wheel flange and rear collar, Ø27 waist, 21.5 mm long; three rear pilot holes for P8, four front wheel holes. Ø19.3 bearing bore. Earlier hub without rear holes is superseded; physical fit and load remain unqualified.

name: Hub spacer
identify: Plain ring: 9.5 mm outside diameter, 6.3 mm bore, 3 mm thick; no peripheral screw holes.

name: Upper deck
identify: 164 x 120 x 4 mm plate; retained unchanged for the U1 deck and board assembly.

name: Drive-lead restraint
identify: Small open stand with two chassis holes and two cable-tie slots.

name: Idler bearing cap
identify: Ø30 x 2 ring, Ø17 opening, three countersunk holes. Shallow circular relief faces bearing; countersunk screw heads face carrier. Attaches to revised P3 with three H8 screws.

name: OpenCR adapter
identify: 92 x 112 x 3 mm plate, central 44 x 60 window; replaces the thin-edged 84 mm-wide legacy adapter. Four slotted board holes, four round deck fixing holes.

name: Pi 4B adapter
identify: 64 x 96 x 3 mm plate, central 34 x 50 window; 49 x 58 board pattern, 48 x 80 deck pattern. Pi USB/Ethernet face the robot's left side.
